## Description

Constructs persistence landscapes and Betti curves from sliding multi-asset correlation point clouds, tracking topological holes to detect systemic market fragility before liquidity crashes occur.

## Where it may fit

Pre-crash market environments, systemic credit crunches, sudden cross-asset correlation breakdowns.

## Vehicles

Tail-risk hedge funds, institutional risk management desks, global macro funds.

## Required data

Rolling correlation matrices across large asset universes, high-frequency return vectors.

## Caveats

Persistent homology computation is memory-intensive; threshold selection for Vietoris-Rips complexes is critical.
